goal_winback.sentence: Approve ran 28 days: it would have made about $4,600 a month ($3,900 to $5,300), and the people we never contact confirm it ($900 to $7,700).
goal_winback.detail: The goal is active in approve. 28 of 28 days at approve. 6900 of 100 contact decisions have a closed outcome window. Forecast over closed windows $4,300 ($3,650 to $4,950). Against the people we never contact it made $4,300 ($900 to $7,700); its forecast for the same messages was $4,100. No safety stop in the last 14 days. The data is trusted. Its signed limits are active. A forecast is the agent's own estimate of extra profit after offer and message costs, summed over the contacts it chose; the monthly figure is that sum at the rate of the days it ran. Proof compares everyone it could contact with the people we never contact, over closed outcome windows.
